			}

}

	next_building = castle_larder_2
	cost_gold = regular_building_cost_tier_1
	construction_time = construction_time_6_months
	district_level_requirement = 3
	can_construct = {
	}
	can_construct_potential = {
	}
	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
	}
	province_modifier = {
		monthly_civic_tax = poor_building_tax_halved_tier_1
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_cattle_sell_price_mult = price_holding_district_need
	}
	market_rite_modifier = {
		parameter = meat_buildings_forbidden
		trade_category_cereals_sell_price_mult = price_holding_district_need
	}
	market_rite_modifier = {
		parameter = meat_buildings_forbidden_slain
		trade_category_cereals_sell_price_mult = price_holding_district_need
	}
	market_rite_modifier = {
		parameter = fish_permitted
		trade_good_fish_sell_price_mult = price_holding_district_need
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_cattle
		amount = holding_district_resource_need
		not_culture_parameter = vegetarianism_no_meat_buildings
		not_rite_parameter = meat_forbidden
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				stationed_maa_maintenance_low_modifier = -0.02
				stationed_maa_maintenance_high_modifier = -0.02
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_cereals
		amount = holding_district_resource_need
		culture_parameter = vegetarianism_no_meat_buildings
		not_rite_parameter = meat_forbidden
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				stationed_maa_maintenance_low_modifier = -0.02
				stationed_maa_maintenance_high_modifier = -0.02
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good_category = trade_category_cereals
		amount = holding_district_resource_need
		rite_parameter = meat_forbidden
		not_rite_parameter = fish_permitted
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				stationed_maa_maintenance_low_modifier = -0.02
				stationed_maa_maintenance_high_modifier = -0.02
			}
		}
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_fish
		amount = holding_district_resource_need
		rite_parameter = fish_permitted
		modifiers = {
			province_modifier = {
				stationed_maa_maintenance_low_modifier = -0.02
				stationed_maa_maintenance_high_modifier = -0.02
			}
		}

	trade_good_need = { # Elf Destiny
